column1: # Items whose label ends with an ellipsis in Thunderbird 160, for `tb_shot.py tour` (#56).
# Measured 2026-11-11 in en-US with the dummy IMAP account, by clicking each one.
# page: a Settings pane, or an Account Settings page (PageTag of the tree row)
# target: an element ID, or css:SELECTOR for an element with no ID
# group: open (a dialog in the tab, a separate window, or an HTML dialog),
#        tab (a new Thunderbird tab, such as about:config: saved, then closed),
#        file (the operating system's file dialog, only with --file-dialogs),
#        menu (a drop-down menu, skipped), goto (goes to a Settings pane, skipped).
# "Generate and save a CSR file as…" is open, not file: it opens an introduction
# prompt first, and the file dialog only after Continue.
# The tour skips an item that is hidden or disabled when it gets there.
